title: Explore community administration
description: Use the shared admin navigation, member and release searches, snapshot metrics and refresh controls.

steps.caption: 1. Overview brings artist reviews, member discovery and release activity into one workspace.
2. Browse members opens a searchable directory with community profile links.
3. A search with no results offers Clear search, without losing the directory.
4. Releases lists community uploads, their owners and engagement counts.
5. Refresh data retrieves a new snapshot. The dashboard does not claim to be an always-live feed.
